items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: With Paul Moyer playing drum and Sammy Hopkins playing piano.

ctx.x: If he was playing drum. I said Paul Moyer played drum, but Oynice Moyer was the clarinet. Oynice. Oynice, Paul Moyer's brother. Yeah, because when I first went to the opera house, that's who I went to the opera house with, you know. With Paul Moyer playing drum and Sammy Hopkins playing piano.
